title: ic-backup v1 explicit operation dependency graph
description: Immutable bounded dependencies over exact opaque operation identities. Runtime verifies unique sequences, closed prerequisite references, acyclicity and aggregate edge bounds. The graph contains no effect payload, inventory/request/release binding, budgets, authority or receipts; it is one component of a future complete plan. Duplicate JSON fields reject at runtime.
x-topological-order: Repeatedly emit the smallest currently ready sequence; computed order is not persisted. Order grants no effect authority or dispatch permission. Application dependencies are explicitly integration-qualified, not inferred from inventory parents.

encoding: ASCII ic-backup/effect-graph/v1 followed by one zero byte
Canonical sorted node count: unsigned u32 big-endian
For each node in ascending operation_sequence order: unsigned u64 big-endian operation_sequence followed by unsigned u32 big-endian direct prerequisite count
Each prerequisite in ascending numeric order: unsigned u64 big-endian operation_sequence
excluded: all operation payloads, authority and receipts

operation_sequence.description: Exact opaque operation identity; zero and nonconsecutive sequences are allowed.

items.description: Exact opaque operation identity; zero and nonconsecutive sequences are allowed.
